+# Transforms that make a linear model expressive enough for nonlinear rules.
+PAIR_PRODUCTS = True          # include x_i * x_j for i < j

+LOG_SCALE = 1e-12           # floor for log to avoid -inf on edge values

+THRESHOLD = True            # include soft tanh of (v - t) / s
+RADIUS_T = 1.5            # radius cut-off threshold

+X5_BIN_EDGES = [-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5]  # interval edges for x5
+# Log-bin features for skewed x3
+BIN_X3_LOG = True         # one-hot bins over log(x3) intervals
+X3_LOG_BIN_EDGES = [-2.0, -1.0, 0.0, 1.0]  # interval edges for log(x3)
+# Interaction between radius and log-x3
+RADIUS_LOG_X3 = True
